correctness.rationale: Every same-spectrum word has the target symbol totals and exactly t transitions of each orientation. Sandwich-factor presence and (k-1)-run factors force all short runs to the original lengths and all long runs to length at least k-1. Redistributing the latter preserves every mixed k-window; constant letter totals fix pure windows. A bijection to cyclic pairs of weak compositions gives Burnside’s exact count, and explicit inequivalent excess distributions prove the sharp threshold. Finite checks: 568 exhaustive parameter/read cases, 8,914 necklaces and 26,160 constructed-word comparisons.

value.rationale: The theorem solves the complete noiseless cyclic assembly fiber, at every read length, of a natural infinite family of highly repetitive two-run sources. Exact ambiguity sizes and all reconstructible realizations quantify homopolymer-run uncertainty, and the 1+max(a,b) read-length threshold is sharp. This is more than a finite census or a renamed count; known orbit tools only apply after the source-specific k-spectrum equivalence is proved.
